{"scratch": "Morning (05:00-08:00) counter_k1 patterns: Holds phones, mugs, notebooks, chargers, lunchboxes. 05:36: phones/mugs/notebooks/chargers present; lunchboxes/bottles/pan absent. 06:17: durable items only; phones absent. By 09:00+: phone_marisol leaves counter (prob <0.15); phone_nico persists. Mugs drop to <0.10 by 10:00. Pens/pots appear in common set by 10:00. Resident presence dictates location: if resident_1 at counter, raise prob for their items (charger, notebook, mug) to 0.80-0.90. If resident in bedroom, raise prob for personal items in bed/nightstand to 0.60-0.75 only if the resident is resting.

Daytime (10:00+) counter_k1 patterns: If resident_2 at counter, lower phone_marisol to 0.10; keep phone_nico 0.90. Mugs/notebook/lunchbox/charger persist. Confirmed: phones/charger/notebook/lunchbox 0.90, mug_marisol 0.85, mug_talia 0.10, keys_nico 0.05.

Cupboard_k1: For 10:00+, if resident_2 at cupboard, lower keys_nico to 0.10; keep other keys <0.05. Cupboard is not a key storage spot for Nico in this context.

Sink_k1: Primary storage for shared cookware. For 10:00+, if resident_2 at sink, raise prob for shared pans/pots/plates to 0.80-0.90; lower ON_PERSON to <0.10. Morning (05:00-08:00), if sink empty of people, raise pan/pot to 0.90, lower plate to 0.30. Shared cookware persists in sink even when unoccupied."}
